cluster_reason: StrTokenizer, StrMatcher and StrBuilder form a tightly coupled trio: they reference each other frequently and implement low-level string parsing and building functionality. They have many package-private interactions and represent a cohesive parsing/utility subdomain that can be isolated without moving major high-level components (like formatters).

blocks.goal: Move the selected cohesive cluster to a new subpackage.

ops.details: Create the destination subpackage org.apache.commons.lang3.text.util if it does not exist.
Move StrTokenizer to org.apache.commons.lang3.text.util to colocate parsing logic with related helpers.
Move StrMatcher to org.apache.commons.lang3.text.util to keep token matching implementations alongside the tokenizer.
Move StrBuilder to org.apache.commons.lang3.text.util to group mutable string building utilities with tokenizer/matcher.
